experimental_method: Isopiestic vapour-pressure method at 25 +- 0.01 C: NaCl+CaCl2 solutions equilibrated against NaCl reference solutions; composition from weight loss or gain of water.
uncertainties_stated: thermostat 25 +- 0.01 C; no explicit uncertainty on molalities
quality_remarks: CaCl2 contained 2 ppm Na, 10 ppm K, 300 ppm Sr (flame photometry); concentration of stock by coulometric titration. Equilibration 3-7 days. Three printed rows deviate from R=M_B/(m_B+1.5 m_C) by more than 6e-4 (set 2 M_B 0.7988 pure CaCl2 row 0.9959 vs printed .9980; set 5 M_B 1.7785 row 2 1.0606 vs 1.0595; set 6 M_B 2.7546 row 1 1.0486 vs 1.0497); image confirmed these as printed, so M_B is likely the nominal/mean reference molality and R(obs) uses the individual reference molality; not corrected.
not_extracted_tables: Table 2 (parameters a, b of eq (1) and integral): fitted/derived
Table 3 (values of alpha_B, alpha_C from Table 1 data): derived
Table 5 (excess free energy of mixing): derived

row_counts.table_1: printed 69 data rows (incl. pure CaCl2 rows) in 10 sets; written 69

extraction_notes: The text layer is OCR of a scan with many errors (O/0, dropped digits, 0.54<>8 etc.), so Table 1 was transcribed entirely from the 300 dpi page image and the text layer used only as a cross-check. Sanity: every row checked by script that R(obs)=M_B/(m_B+1.5 m_C) and y_C=1.5 m_C/(m_B+1.5 m_C) within 6e-4 (all rows pass or listed in report). R(obs) falls with y_C only in set 1 (as in Fig. 1).
needs_pass2_reason: OCR/scan source; table read from image only
